name: UPSC CSE
source: UPSC Civil Services Examination notification, Appendix I (scheme and syllabus of the Preliminary and Main examinations)
note: Draft for subject-expert verification (prerequisite 9). Prelims GS Paper I and CSAT, Mains Essay and GS Papers I-IV, down to the syllabus topics as worded in the notification. Optional subjects and the qualifying language papers are not included.

subjects.name: General Studies Paper I
topics: Current Events of National and International Importance
History of India and Indian National Movement
Indian and World Geography - Physical, Social, Economic Geography of India and the World
Indian Polity and Governance - Constitution, Political System, Panchayati Raj, Public Policy, Rights Issues
Economic and Social Development - Sustainable Development, Poverty, Inclusion, Demographics, Social Sector Initiatives
General Issues on Environmental Ecology, Biodiversity and Climate Change
General Science

subjects.name: General Studies Paper II (CSAT)
topics: Comprehension
Interpersonal Skills including Communication Skills
Logical Reasoning and Analytical Ability
Decision Making and Problem Solving
General Mental Ability
Basic Numeracy
Data Interpretation

subjects.name: Essay
topics: Essay Writing on Multiple Topics

subjects.name: General Studies Paper I
topics: Indian Culture - Art Forms, Literature and Architecture from Ancient to Modern Times
Modern Indian History from the Middle of the Eighteenth Century
The Freedom Struggle - Stages and Important Contributors
Post-independence Consolidation and Reorganisation

topics: Indian Constitution - Evolution, Features, Amendments and Basic Structure

Bilateral, Regional and Global Groupings and Agreements

subjects.name: General Studies Paper III
topics: Indian Economy - Planning, Mobilisation of Resources, Growth, Development and Employment
